FN-UKUCXXX-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 82
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/18/2025
House Bill 82 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an
estimated maximum of $3.2 million to increase the state-paid salary of all registrars in the state
from $80 per day, currently, to $150 per day.
Page 1

FN-UKUCXXX-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 82
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/19/2025
House Bill 82 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund could increase
the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $1.6 million to increase
the state-paid salary of all registrars in the state from $80 per day, currently, to $115 per day.
